regulation: Real Decreto 1055/2022 de envases y residuos de envases
title: Spain: RPP registration and SCRAP membership
summary: A business placing packaging on the Spanish market must be entered in the Registro de Productores de Producto (packaging section) held by MITECO, join a collective scheme (SCRAP) such as Ecoembes or Ecovidrio, and file an annual declaration. There is no volume threshold — the duty applies from the first unit.

sources.title: Real Decreto 1055/2022, de 27 de diciembre, de envases y residuos de envases (BOE-A-2022-22690)
sources.note: Fetched the statute directly, resolving the 13 Sept draft's 'unconfirmed article' note. Art. 14 creates the packaging section of the Registro de Productores de Productos; Art. 15 is the registration duty itself ('Los productores de producto ... se inscribirán en la sección de envases del Registro de Productores de Productos ... en el plazo de tres meses'); Art. 16 is the annual information duty. No general volume threshold gates registration -- confirmed correct as drafted -- though a MITECO guidance note (below) describes a lighter 'declaración simplificada' path for producers placing under 15 tonnes/year; that is a reporting-form simplification, not a registration exemption, so it does not change applies_when.

sources.title: MITECO — Nota interpretativa sobre inscripción en el RPP (sección de envases)
sources.note: MITECO's own interpretive note, issued in response to registration questions. Confirms Art. 15's three-month registration window and, separately, that a producer with no Spanish-appointed authorised representative is not itself excused from the RPP -- the first Spain-based distributor picks up the obligation instead (same fallback as es.epr.authorised-representative, same batch), and must register with a simplified declaration if that is the only packaging it is handling.
